recipe: K60 (vclock.Recipe defaults: FF_TIME_TARGET 1793, warmup 20, FF_ACCUM_SCHED 1:0.06,2:0.2,4, MTP phases [0.2, 0.45], cooldown 0.60 linear, insurance at [9.0], startup excluded 5)

reference.note: PROVISIONAL: research/sim-data/chipC has no C41_cold_K60/train.log (only its step count and charged seconds are known, from the monitor), so the triple comes from C40_cold_K59. After `python -m ffsim harvest --chip C` re-run `python -m ffsim.gpu.fleet schedule --write`.
